note: people_id -> VoteApp candidate id for the Oregon 2025 Regular Session (LegiScan 2191). Seats in these notes come from LegiScan's `district` field, which is the reliable one here: its `role` field contradicts it, printing senators as "house" beside an SD- district, so seat logic reads district and never role. Mapped entries are the 52 proposals from rollcall:legiscan:resolve, every one checked by hand, plus 9 pairs the proposer cannot reach: six are the nickname class (LegiScan keeps the legal first name while the ballot carries the working one), one is a shortened multi-part surname, and two are sitting members running for statewide office, who fall outside the state-legislative candidate pool by design. Explicit nulls are members with no Nov-2026 state-legislative candidacy; 16 of them hold Senate seats that are not on the 2026 ballot at all, because Oregon staggers its Senate.
